column1: Mix the baking powder, salt and flour.
Melt the butter, then mix it with the sugar. Add the vanilla and egg.
Gradually combine the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients.
Roll the dough into a ball and refrigerate at least 30 minutes.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 6–8 minutes (estimate), until the edges are just set and barely golden. Let cool completely.
For the frosting, melt the butter in a pot. Remove from the heat and stir in the milk.
Gradually add the confectioners' sugar until thick, then add food coloring. Stir until no lumps remain.
To make the frosting thicker, beat in more confectioners' sugar 1/4 cup at a time, or chill it 10–15 minutes and stir again. Using a little less milk next time also helps.
